A Family-Oriented Veterinary Clinic. 

Al Hayat was established in the year 2020, out of the growing need of 𝐃𝐮𝐛𝐚𝐢's pet community to access quality care which was both affordable and came from a place of love and adoration for your furry friends. 

Founded by Dr. AbdulMuttaleb Kalaji, an esteemed veterinarian with over 40 years of experience working with the Dubai Municipality, the idea of Al Hayat’s conception came to Dr AbdulMuttaleb from a very personal space.

“I saw how most of the vet clinics and grooming services around the city had become centres of business instead of a safe place for our little furry friends.
I recognized the need to have an institution that prioritized the wellbeing of our pets above everything else.”

‍Our family-owned clinic is dedicated to giving your pets the best care with our extensive facilities, kind experience, regular follow-ups and tips for after-service care.

Reach out to us: +971 58 593 1952
